Make ONE character only, repeated in TWO full-body views across a wide landscape canvas. Do not broaden shoulders to compensate for height. Hard-edged restrained cel shading and clean pixel clusters, not painterly or realistic; avoid mushy dither and smooth airbrushed shading.
